messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Fegurðin á Hornströndum er ólýsanleg og tilhugsunin um að fólk hafi búið þarna í mörghundruð ár á hjara veraldar fyllir mann bjartsýni um þrautsegju Íslendinga. Skortur á síma- og netsambandi leyfir manni að öðlast hugarró á þessum ysta sjó.

message.content: The beauty of Hornstrandir is incomparable, and the thought that people have lived there for several hundred years at the edge of the world fills a person with admiration for the endurance of Icelanders. The lack of phone and internet connections allows a person to gain mental peace on this most remote sea.
